Temukan jawaban seputar pemesanan tiket: Find answers about South Kalimantan tourism ticket booking
Bagaimana cara memesan tiket wisata seca: How to book tourist tickets online?
faq_answer_1: Select the tourist destination you want on the Tourism Catalog page, click "View Details & Tickets", then click "Book Tickets Now". Fill in your personal information, choose the number and type of tickets, then click "Proceed to Payment". You will receive an order code to track your ticket status.
Apakah saya wajib membuat akun untuk mem: Do I need to create an account to book tickets?
faq_answer_2: No, it's not mandatory. You can order tickets without an account (just fill in your name, WhatsApp, and email at checkout). However, if you register, all your order history will be automatically saved and accessible anytime in the "Order History" menu.
Apakah ada diskon untuk rombongan/kelomp: Are there discounts for groups/large parties?
faq_answer_3: Yes. Our system automatically provides group discounts if the number of tickets in a single transaction reaches a certain minimum. The discount will be directly visible in the payment summary at checkout — no special code needed.
faq_answer_4: Payments can be made via QRIS and various e-wallets (GoPay, OVO, DANA, ShopeePay, LinkAja) as well as mobile banking, directly through the "Check Order" page after placing your order.
Berapa lama batas waktu pembayaran sebel: How long is the payment deadline before the order is cancelled?
faq_answer_5: Unpaid orders will remain with "Unpaid" status and can be completed anytime through the Check Order page using your order code. We recommend completing payment as soon as possible so your visit can be well planned.
faq_answer_6: Yes, all transactions are processed through an encrypted and secure payment system.
Bagaimana cara mendapatkan E-Ticket saya: How do I get my E-Ticket?
faq_answer_7: After payment is confirmed, a complete E-Ticket with QR Code will be automatically available. Simply open the "Check Order" page, enter your order code, then click "Show E-Ticket".
Saya lupa/kehilangan kode pesanan saya,: I forgot/lost my order code, what's the solution?
faq_answer_8: The order code is usually sent to the email you registered during checkout. If you have a visitor account, you can also view all order history (including order codes) through the "Order History" menu after logging in.
Apakah E-Ticket bisa dipakai berkali-kal: Can the E-Ticket be used multiple times?
faq_answer_9: No. The QR Code on the E-Ticket is only valid for one-time entry validation (scanned once by the officer at the tourist site). Make sure you have the E-Ticket ready (screenshot or phone display) when you arrive.
